page.layout: One printed page of running text in a single column, with a marginal number "14" to the right beside the line "Sed dicis intelligenda"; the left edge shows show-through and fragments of the facing page, which are not transcribed. Running head at top; page number at top right.

main_text.p: modis poteft explicari; quàm in ipsa interpretatione, quem in sensum Metonymiam nostram declaremus sit respiciendum. Et ita Ioh. Pincier in scriptis Eucharist. tract. 3. cap. 11. explicat Metonymiam: Qui, inquit, Metonymiam malunt, cognationem & arctam connexionem inter signa & res significatas respiciunt: Cyprianum in hoc imitati, qui diversa nomina vel species ad unam reduci essentiam ait (Sacramenti scilicet, quod constat signis & rebus significatis) & significantia & significata eisdem vocabulis censeri: ita ut symbola ipsa nominibus rerum significatarum nuncupentur, & vice versa, nomina Elementorum ad ipsa significata transferantur. Vides eodem plane modo & Theodoretum ipsum Coenae mysterium, & Pincierum explicare Metonymiam, ut propterea de vocabulo periculum non sit, dummodo constet de reipsa. Et ita fundamentum Metonymicae appellationis ponimus in unione sacramentali.

Sed dicis intelligenda verba: non essentialiter, nec significativè, sed sacramentali unione: non ergo Metonymicè, hæc enim figura videtur esse explicanda significativè. Sed hæc ignoratio Elenchi est, nec enim esse significativum, & esse sacramentale, adeoq; unio14

page.notes: Left margin carries fragments of the facing page, not transcribed. The marginal "14" is a note on the right. Several words are blurred by damp staining; "Metonymiam" and "Pincier" read with some doubt. The sentence ending "unio" continues on the next page.
